entities.summary: Swiss German University (SGU) is a private international university located in Tangerang, Banten, Indonesia. Established in 2000, SGU is recognized as the first international university in Indonesia to offer an international curriculum and double-degree programs in collaboration with partner universities in Switzerland, Germany, and other countries. SGU provides undergraduate and postgraduate programs across engineering, information technology, business, communication, and life sciences. The university is accredited by the National Accreditation Board for Higher Education (BAN-PT) under the Ministry of Higher Education, Science, and Technology of the Republic of Indonesia.
